en: Catalogue of Imported Works Outside the Official Record:
Including the *Catalogue of Imported Works Outside the Official Record* and the *Brief Exposition of the Thirty-Seven Deities of the Vajraśekhara Yoga: The Essential Heart-Mind*, one fascicle.
*The Dharma of the Immovable Wisdom King for the Peaceful Stabilization of the State*, one fascicle;
*The Great Sādhana Ritual Manual for the Vairocanābhisambodhi Sūtra*, two fascicles, transmitted by the Tripiṭaka Master Vajrabodhi to Emperor Guangda;
*The Ritual Manual for the Maṇḍala, Homa, and Hūṃ-offerings*, one fascicle; *The Sūtra on the Ritual Manual for the Accomplishment of the Vajrakumāra*, one fascicle.
*The Essential Instructions for the Dhāraṇī Sūtra for Bestowing upon Hungry Ghosts*, one scroll; the above is extracted from the *Catalogue of the Lotus King Monastery*.
*The Ritual Manual of the Victorious Uṣṇīṣa*, one scroll; *The Sūtra on Stopping Wind*, one scroll;

*The Ritual Manual for Attaining Buddhahood through Recitation at Any Time or Place via the Yoga of the One-Syllable Cakravartin King from the Vajraśekhara Sūtra*, one scroll; and the *Siddham* by Kumārajīva.
Chapter One: The *Siddha* Chapter on Campā City.
The Great and Wondrous Sūtra of the *Mahāvairocana-sūtra Susiddhi* and the *Rāgarāja-maṇḍala*, containing the Supreme Mantra Method of the Buddha-Mother Rāgavidyārājñī.
Recorded by Kōbō Daishi. [Six external sections]. Or alternatively, recorded by Jōkō. [External Jōkō Record]. The *Mahāvairocana-buddhatva-abhisambodhi-mantra*.
*The Sūtra on the Transformation and Empowerment*, one fascicle, seven scrolls; *The Buddha-spoken Sūtra of the Great General of Ghosts and Spirits, Aṭavaka*, three scrolls;
*The Aṭabhuja Ghost and Spirit Great General’s Superior Buddha-dhāraṇī Sūtra*, one scroll;
*The Ritual Manual for the Great Marshal Ghost and Spirit Great General, Aṭapabhuja*. The above six titles are from the Lotus King Court catalog.
*The Ritual Manual for the Sequence of Recitation from the Mahāvairocana Sūtra*, one fascicle;
*The Commentary on the Ritual of Offerings to Mahāvairocana*, two fascicles. The above were recorded by Rengeō-in.
Furthermore, *The Teachings of the Womb Realm (Garbhadhātu) and the Diamond Names of the Vajradhātu*, one fascicle, was privately included in the E-un Record. [Excluded from the E-un Record. Great.
The Vairocanābhisambodhi-sūtra, one volume in seven fascicles; the Vajraśekhara-yoga-tattva-mahātantra-abhisaṃbodhi-mahātantrarāja-sūtra, one volume in three fascicles;
the Ritual for Receiving the Bodhicitta Precepts, one fascicle;
the Ritual Manual for the Recitation Sequence of the Mahāvairocana Sūtra, one fascicle; and the Heart of the Lotus Family of the Vajraśekhara.
*The Method for Recitation*, one fascicle; *Commentary on the Meaning of the Buddha-uṣṇīṣa-vijaya-dhāraṇī*, one fascicle;
*The Ritual Manual for the Recitation of the Cintāmaṇicakra of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva*, one fascicle;
*The Chapter on the Five-Syllable Heart Dhāraṇī of Mañjuśrī Bodhisattva from the Vajraśekhara Sūtra*, one fascicle; *The Ritual Manual for the Yoga Homa of the Vajraśekhara*, one fascicle.
One fascicle of the *Dhāraṇī-samaya-Acalanātha-krūrarāja-dūta-japa-vidhi*.
The above was recorded in the catalog of the Lotus King Court (*Padmarājamaṇḍala*). One fascicle of the *Vajradhātu-vajra-guhyasaṃjñā* with annotations by Huiguo.
Three fascicles of the *Mahāmāyūrī-vidyārājñī-sūtra*. One fascicle of the *Mahāmaṅgala-stotra*. The Womb Realm (*Garbhadhātu*) teachings and the Golden... [text ends].
*The Diamond Realm: Names of the Vajras*, one fascicle;
*Private Notes on the Meaning of the Emergence of the Thirty-Seven Honored Ones of the Vajraśekhara Yoga*, one fascicle; *The Record Outside the Zen Forest Catalogues*;
*The Mahāvairocana Sūtra of Divine Transformation and Empowerment*, seven fascicles; *The Rucira Sūtra*, three fascicles; *Vajraśekhara Yoga*.
*The Great King of True Teachings Sūtra*, one volume in three fascicles; *The Essentials of Meditation by the Tripiṭaka Master Abhaya*, one volume;
*The Method for Entering the Maṇḍala and Receiving Empowerment for Vajra Disciples*, one volume; *The Ritual for the Bodhicitta Precepts of the Supreme Vehicle of Empowerment*, one volume;
*The Names of the Vajras of the Womb Realm Teaching*, one volume; and *The Meaning of Mahāvairocana*.
One section comprising fourteen fascicles; *The Essential Meaning of the Mantras Remaining from the Brief [Exposition of] the Mahāvairocana Maṇḍala*, one fascicle;
*The Sūtra on the Essential and Brief Recitation Spoken by Buddha Mahāvairocana*, one fascicle;
*The Method for Five-Limb Recitation: The Swift Door of the Essential and Brief [Exposition of] Mahāvairocana*, one fascicle; and the Five-Syllable Mantra of Vairocana.

*The Ritual Manual for Brief Practice*, one fascicle; *The Ritual Manual for Recitation and Observance of the Vidyādhara Precepts during the Six Months of the World from the Commentary on the Mahāvairocana Sūtra*, one fascicle;

and *The Yoga for Accomplishing Mantras through Thorough Mastery of the Lotus Womb Maṇḍala and its Banner Emblems from the Mahāvairocana Sūtra of the Buddha’s Enlightenment and Spiritual Transformation*, three fascicles.
*Vajraśekhara-yoga-saṃkṣipta-trisaptati-devatā-hṛdaya-arahas*, one fascicle;
*Vajraśikhara-kūṭāgāra-sarva-yoga-yoginī-sūtra*, one fascicle; *Sarvabuddha-viṣaya-tattva-nirdeśa-dharma*, one work in three fascicles;
*Rāṣṭrapāla-rakṣā-dhāraṇī-sūtra*, one work in ten fascicles; *Mahāyāna-naya-ṣaṭpāramitā*.
One fascicle of the *Pāramitā Sūtra* in six volumes; one fascicle of the *Mahāyāna Citta-bhūmi-darśana Sūtra* in eight volumes;
one fascicle of the *Vajraśekhara Yoga Eighteen Assemblies Index*;
one fascicle of the *Treatise on Arousing the Mind for Anuttara-samyak-saṃbodhi in Vajraśekhara Yoga*; [and] the *Vajraśekhara Yoga Cultivation of Vairocana*... [truncated].
One fascicle on the *Mudrā* Method; one fascicle on the Ritual Manual of the Holy Yamāntaka, King of Fierce Wrath;
one fascicle on the Mantra Method of Mañjuśrī-Yamāntaka; one fascicle on the Ritual Manual for *Homa* from the Single Chapter of the *Vajrajñāna-yoginī Sūtra*;
one fascicle on the Bloodline of the Ācārya Sāgaramati regarding the Eight Seals of the *Pratyaṅgirā*; and the Dharanis of the Five Families.
The *Niwenda Monjushiri Enmandeka Hō* (The Ritual of Mañjuśrī and Yamāntaka), one fascicle. The above has been recorded using the Lotus King Court (Renge-ō-in) system.
It is included in the Right Five Houses Catalogue (*Gyōgo-roku*) and other collections, specifically within the Lotus King Court Catalogue.
The other three schools do not possess this.
It is something that was externally added based on what was seen in books, and it should be recorded upon hearing [of it].
It was secretly produced by the masters of those other three traditions.

*Catalogue*, *External Catalogue*, *External Catalogue*, *Ritual Procedures for the Sequence of Recitation*, *Brief Compendium of the Mahāvairocana Sūtra: Methods for Following Recitation*, one fascicle; [Works of] the Three Schools of Other Sects; [Works of] the Three Schools of Other Sects; Excluded from Saichō’s Catalogue (missing); Excluded from Saichō’s Catalogue; Excluded from Ennin’s Catalogue; Excluded from Ennin’s Catalogue, *The Essential Core of the Thirty-Seven Deities of the Vajraśekhara Yoga*, one fascicle; *Methods for Mental Application in the Zen Gate*, one fascicle; *One Sheet of the Mantra for Pacifying Dwellings with Acala*; *Ritual Procedures for Establishing Maṇḍalas and Performing Homa*, one fascicle; [Excluded from Ennin’s Catalogue?]; *The Vajraśekhara Yoga: A Brief Extract of the Recitation Sūtra*, one work in six fascicles; *The Recitation Method of the Holy Lord Acala of the Tattvasamaya*, three fascicles; Excluded from Enchin’s Catalogue; Excluded from Enchin’s Catalogue, *The Susiddhi Offering Ritual*, two fascicles; Abhayākaragupta.

*The Abridged Version of the Buddha-uṣṇīṣa-vijaya-dhāraṇī*, one fascicle; *The Expanded Version with Added Characters*, one fascicle; *The Ritual for the Unobstructed Feast for the Departed Spirits*, one fascicle; *The Method for Offerings to the Fifty Devas and the Eighty Non-Offering Rites*, one fascicle; *The Great Praise in Sanskrit Script*, one fascicle; *The Praise of the Three Bodies*, one fascicle; *The Secret Essentials of the Gaṇapati Yoga: Annotated Thousand-Rayed Eye*, one fascicle; *The Secret Lotus-Uṣṇīṣa Yoga Accomplishment Method of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva*, one fascicle; *The Six-Syllable Dharma*, one fascicle. On the eighteenth day of the fifth month in the eighth year of Kenchō.
This was annotated by Gakudōin of Murasaka Taimyō.
As it was recorded based on what was seen, please add further notes as necessary;
there are likely many errors.
Later worthies will surely edit and revise it;
the Vajra Son is most venerable.
